preserved_v1.interpretation: Its 3.8 damage number is the exclusive mothership contribution without external terms, not an unconditional prediction for the Machine preset aggregate.

scope: No natural-growth C0 or later damage aggregate read by this agent
Known country sources added before actual aggregate observation
Existing H/A/S source bases and controlled hardware evidence retained; not every civic shares the same absolute baseline

known_country_sources.applicability: Current Machine preset as identified by the main task; verify the actual native government still contains the civic.
Only when this base civic is active; not assumed for Machine. Swapped display names are not separate simultaneously stacking bonuses.
Only when active; distinct fire-rate channel, not +0.33 damage. Not assumed for Machine.

machine_damage_source_accounting.formula_before_power_visibility_decision: ship damage aggregate = 4.05 + 0.05*L + 0.05*Nd + other included sources. The engine-generated excess-power contribution may be one of these sources; do not double-count it.
machine_damage_source_accounting.not_claimed: No claim that the native C0 aggregate is exactly 4.05, and no native C0 damage value has been obtained by this agent.

excess_power.native_comment: 0.5 means 0-50% excess power linearly scales ship_excess_power modifier between 0-1.
what_source_proves: There is a distinct engine-scaled named source with a ship_weapon_damage payload of 0.1 at full scaling.
Its companion fields are ship_evasion_mult and ship_speed_mult, both 0.1.
This is not the core tier or the exclusive mothership static modifier.
what_source_does_not_prove: No public engine function is present here proving which modifier holder receives this scaled source.
Distinct named source does not establish a separate multiplicative damage stage.
Source alone does not prove whether export_modifier_to_variable on the actual ship includes the entire power contribution.
The native comment and thresholds do not establish a complete formula for every threshold edge; do not import an unverified wiki formula.
excess_power.safe_symbolic_payload: 0.1*P_excess where the engine scaling factor is between 0 and 1; placement in exported aggregate versus other damage-calculation stages remains to be observed.
excess_power.differential_expectation: With the same actual design and reactor, six zero-power cores, unchanged country/leader/technology/temporary sources and no power-related external changes, changing L or the persistent core ranks does not change the declared power supply or component consumption. Treat the excess-power term as fixed for the C/L/N comparison, rather than inferring it from a later tier result.

preferred_C0_baseline_plan.timing: Obtain on the clean same-fixture C0 baseline before changing C or core ranks, after at least five days of triggered-modifier refresh.
record: actual installed design including reactor and all six cores
all ten v1 core modifier exports on the actual Mother ship
L and six saved ranks; initial values should be independently checked
optional power budget UI/source values and ship_speed_mult/ship_evasion_mult exports if investigating power visibility
procedure: Save the paused C0 native baseline and its diagnostic exports.
Use these actual aggregates as fixed comparison intercepts only; retain their provenance and do not tune source coefficients.
Read each later saved L and N independently, then evaluate the pre-fixed delta formulas below.
When an external modifier, design, power supply/consumption or ownership changes, establish a new independent baseline or explicitly account for the changed source before comparing.
do_not_do: Do not backsolve core tiers from measured damage.
Do not call an unattributed C0 residual an excess-power measurement.
Do not treat a panel DPS ratio as a ship_weapon_damage export.
Do not read a later core result and retroactively select a C0 constant that makes it pass.

delta_model_from_actual_baseline.notation: Deltas are current minus independently captured baseline. The baseline can have nonzero L0 and N0, but the intended clean fixture is C0/L0/all tiers0.
conditions: The same RC3 equipment and design basis remain fixed.
No additional flat hull/armor/shield terms change the effective 30000/25740/41827.5 source bases.
All other applicable country, leader, technology, aura, temporary and power sources remain fixed or are separately accounted.
At least five days pass after changing relevant ranks or L before judging triggered modifier refresh.
These fixed source coefficients remain hypotheses for native engine evaluation in channels not yet proved; no six-channel runtime PASS is implied.

absolute_model_boundaries.H_A_S: The v1 no-external-terms max formulas retain their source meaning. Existing Machine hardware baselines support them in that controlled fixture; a Hive +0.25 hull country term changes the intercept. Do not apply one civic-specific baseline universally.
absolute_model_boundaries.damage: 3.8 is one source, 4.05 is the known Machine source subtotal; neither is automatically the full native aggregate.
absolute_model_boundaries.tracking: 15 is the frozen Sensor4 source contribution, plus other real tracking sources if present. Prefer the actual C0 aggregate intercept.
absolute_model_boundaries.fixed_regen: 1.392 and 2.088 are exclusive mothership fixed sources. AUTO_REPAIR, Hive civic and orbit repair use separate percentage fields; do not mix them with fixed regeneration.
absolute_model_boundaries.panel_DPS: Not predicted here; firing rate, accuracy, weapon tags, power handling and other engine stages can affect it.
